        mode="overwrite",
        overwrite_schema=True,

            KEY_ID 'admin',
            SECRET 'password123',
            REGION 'us-east-1',
            ENDPOINT 'minio:9000',
            URL_STYLE 'path',
            USE_SSL false
        );
    """)
